purpose: Validate Field Collector farm_activity lifecycle guards in disposable PostgreSQL.
synthetic_happy_paths: reviewed native draft with matching source digest and event
submitted to verified by a different operator
verified to published by a third operator
rejected exception closed with a separate event and unchanged rejected status
synthetic_guard_rejections: native draft commit without its matching draft_created event
limitations: OIDC provider-backed candidate route acceptance remains open.
Published-only farm report and metric handoffs remain open.
